 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Panthers have dealt with adjustments and recent back-to-back conference losses following injuries to their signal-caller rotation, dropping games to UNC and Boston College after a 5-0 start.
 The Hurricanes are coming off a hard-fought overtime win against Florida State and are now moving on to Pitt. Head coach Mario Cristobal has warned of the Panthers' disruptive, high-pressure defensive front.
 Miami got a 38-7 road win over Pitt last November.
